column1: # Same Bluehost account/SSH key for all. rsync has no --delete — it only
# adds/updates, never removes files already on the server.
# A hub is ALWAYS served from GitHub Pages at
#   https://cabuzzard.github.io/dash/web/hub/{slug}/
# — the home of every hub that has no custom domain yet (e.g. mountainwize).
# Bluehost routing (2026-09-02): the hosting plan is at its 50-website cap, so
# hub domains can't be added as addon domains ("An unknown error occurred").
# Instead each hub domain is PARKED (aliased on evraymond.com) via
#   cpapi2 Park park domain=<domain>
# and a SINGLE generic RewriteRule in ~/public_html/.htaccess routes any host
# whose folder public_html/hub-<host>/ exists to that folder. So the deploy
# target for a hub is public_html/hub-<domain>/ (named by DOMAIN, so the one
# generic rule needs no per-hub edit — just add a line here + park the domain).
# Full runbook: web/hub/BLUEHOST-ROUTING.md. Bluehost DNS / hosting / email
# stay unchanged. Also per hub: worker.js HUB_ORIGINS (apex + www) +
# index.html HUB_SITES[].domain.
# creative-flow-guitar → creativeflowguitar.com predates this and is served the
# old way from ~/creativeflowguitar.com — left as-is, not on the generic rule.
# mountainwize has no domain yet — GitHub Pages only, no line here.
